secrets.details: No hardcoded secrets, tokens, API keys, or credentials found in source files

webview_security.details: JavaScript enabled in WebView (required for web app functionality). File access disabled (allowFileAccess=false). Universal access disabled (allowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs=false).

dependencies.details: androidx.appcompat:1.7.0, androidx.core:core-ktx:1.13.1 — both current, no known CVEs

file_permissions.details: All files at standard 644/755 — no overly permissive files (777)

ios_plist.details: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=true in Info.plist — ATS disabled. This allows the web app to load HTTP resources. Should be tightened with NSExceptionDomains for specific hosts only, or removed if only HTTPS is used.

false_positives: Password in URL flags — all are example text (https://192.168.1.100:3000) not real credentials

summary: No secrets found. No high-risk vulnerabilities. One medium: iOS ATS disabled — should use NSExceptionDomains instead of NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=true.
